content: Claude Code MCP config: claude mcp add --transport http <name> <url>. Writes to ~/.claude.json (user scope) or .mcp.json (project scope). JSON format for .mcp.json: {mcpServers: {name: {type: 'http', url: 'http://localhost:PORT/mcp'}}}. type='streamable-http' is alias for 'http'. SSE transport is deprecated - use HTTP. For local embedded server use 'http' type pointing to localhost. Can also use --mcp-config flag with path to json file containing mcpServers. Settings: .claude/settings.json does not hold mcpServers directly; use .mcp.json at project root for project scope or ~/.claude.json for user scope. Approval needed for .mcp.json servers (workspace trust). Alternative: pass --settings flag or use user scope to auto-approve.
